symptom: Dashboard panels stuck loading after changing the time range
root_cause: Datasource query timeout too low for large Prometheus range queries
resolution: Increase datasource timeout and add query cancellation on time-range change

symptom: Charts freeze and spin forever when auto-refresh is enabled
root_cause: Refresh loop issued overlapping queries without aborting in-flight requests
resolution: Abort prior QueryRunner requests before starting refresh cycle

symptom: Alert rules flapping every evaluation interval
root_cause: Noisy datasource latency caused intermittent no-data evaluations
resolution: Treat transient datasource errors as last-known state with grace period

symptom: Graph panels blank after switching Prometheus datasource
root_cause: Cached query options retained previous datasource UID
resolution: Clear query cache when datasource UID changes

symptom: Time picker zoom makes all visualizations hang
root_cause: Unbounded max data points requested for wide time windows
resolution: Cap maxDataPoints and show partial-result warning

symptom: Panels show spinner forever on slow Loki queries
root_cause: Missing client-side timeout for Explore/Loki log queries
resolution: Enforce default HTTP timeout in Loki datasource plugin
